steps.content: Under Pylgia's warning, the submarine narrowly maneuvers through a maze of mysterious skeletal remains and rocks.
But there's no time for respite—the colossal creature trails closely behind, resembling a leviathan of flesh and bone, smashing through everything in its path.
The massive impacts echo through the Abyss, like the tolling of a demonic bell, signaling impending doom.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ragnar, we need to surface now! No way we can get rid of it in the Abyss.
But Ragnar appears entirely impervious to your words, his entire body stiff as he holds the depth helm at its utmost limit. His bloodshot eyes dart repeatedly to the pressure gauge.
However, when you divert your attention to the pressure gauge, the reading hasn't diminished in the least—instead, the needle is quivering violently towards the right.
You finally realize that as your companion's sanity fractures, some indescribable force is dragging your submarine—tons of solid steel—relentlessly deeper into the Abyss.
